text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —Come back, Mayano!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wh-what... are you doing!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Once again, nice to meet you! I am 
Seeking the Pearl! 
And this is Matikanefukukitaru! Which 
means you must be—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun... I guess...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Phew~, what a lifesaver! With this, our 
three-piece band 
is successfully formed! Exactly as Lady 
Shiraoki foretold!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"From here on out, let's do our best for 
everyone's happiness!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Happiness...?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"That is correct. 
—Fukukitaru! Brilliant Shell, please!!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Listen, Mayano. 
So much diverse music will gather at this 
year's Holy Hoof Festival."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Alternative and soulful music. 
Catchy and danceable music. Et cetera, et 
cetera music."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "And we are—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Happy music! Smiley music! 
Aiming for happy and happy!! Yeeeaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Shake-shake-nah! Shake-shake-nah!! (x2) 
Hyaka-hyaka-nah! Hyaka-hyaka-nah!! (x2)"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Waaaahhh!? Stop, stoooppp!?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"First of all, what is that!? That... 
salmon! 
You were holding a guitar a second ago, 
weren't you!?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "This tuna?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"That's Pearl-san's guitar case! 
Would you like to see my drum set too? It 
has miraculous divine protection!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"???? 
Um... what you two are doing is a 'band', 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Of course it is! A feast for the eyes, a 
feast for the ears— 
make no mistake, we are a happy band 
delivering happiness!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"And you are the final piece we have been 
searching for. 
Come, Mayano, let us intertwine our sounds 
at once!"

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-wh-wh-what do we do! What do we do! 
(Let's go!) 
Topsy-turvy, topsy-turvy! Yoisa, yoisa, 
yoisa, yoisa!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "At least play your instruments~!?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"*Sigh*... The band in the movie was 
way, waaay... cooler than this... 
*Mumble*."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: (The same bass as the main character...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(It felt like diving into a brand new 
world Maya didn't know about, 
so I got super excited and had Papa buy it 
for me, but...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Being 'cool' is supposed to be, like—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, that's amazing!! 
Maya-chan, isn't that a song from the 
movie!? How can you already play it!?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Heh-heh... Maya actually started playing 
the bass! 
I went to see the movie twice! So I 
memorized the whole thing!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Just from watching it!? You little 
genius! 
Starting a band at this time of year means 
it's for the Holy Hoof Festival, right? 
Right~?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely going to come watch your 
band, Maya-chan! 
I just know you're gonna look super 
cool!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "...? Maya-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Well, umm..."

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Oxygen! (Haaah!) Oxygen! (Haaah!) 
Bring us some oxygeeennn!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "...I wonnnndeeerrrrr about thaaat~~...!!"
